pattern: IM-L03 landlord arranges her own contractor, arriving as a correction of an ambiguous emoji (CM)
notes: Event 007 is the base mutation (the landlord's thumbs-up emoji). Appended event 008 (system 'response to landlord' prompt) and event 009, the landlord's email 43 minutes later on Wednesday 27 March 2024: ignore the thumbs-up, she will sort it herself, her plumber Dan Whitlow will ring the tenant to arrange a time, probably early next week. History truncated after event 009. Expected: record the decision as the landlord's own contractor quoting event 009, assign no agency provider, tell the tenant Dan Whitlow will contact her on the landlord's behalf, ask the landlord for the plumber's contact and the date once booked and to confirm when it is done, and set a follow-up. 'Early next week' starts with Easter Monday (1 April 2024), a bank holiday. No escalation.
